headings.usage: Use for screen titles, section headers, and important labels.

body.usage: Use for standard text, descriptions, and list items.

mono.usage: Use for all live price tickers, percentages, and numerical data.

spacing_and_layout.navigation: fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#0A0A0A]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#27272A]
spacing_and_layout.card_style: bg-[#141414] border border-[#27272A] rounded-lg p-4 shadow-sm

components.buttons: rounded-lg font-medium transition-all active:scale-95 text-sm px-4 py-2
components.tabs: flex space-x-2 border-b border-[#27272A] overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar
components.list_item: flex justify-between items-center py-3 border-b border-[#27272A]/50 last:border-0

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white text on Deep Obsidian background for readability.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='buy-button').

icons.usage: Use for bottom tabs (Home, Watchlist, Trade, Portfolio, Settings) and UI indicators.

image_urls.description: Abstract stock market candlestick chart on dark screen for hero/onboarding.
Bull statue representing a bullish market.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build as a mobile-first responsive web app using React and Tailwind.
Use a persistent bottom tab bar for navigation.
Implement dense, tabular data lists for watchlists and portfolios.
Use JetBrains Mono or similar monospaced font for all live prices.
Color code P&L strictly: text-emerald-500 for profit, text-red-500 for loss.
Implement the UI directly using Tailwind and standard Shadcn components.
Ensure the chart area takes priority on the Stock Detail Screen.
Include 'data-testid' on every button, tab, and list row.
